title: Resonant Circuits
description: A capacitor and a coil pass energy back and forth, electric then magnetic, at one frequency of their own. Two such circuits in tune trade it between them - and one can step the voltage up enormously. Unlocks the Tesla Coil.

puzzle.goal: A capacitor of capacitance C discharges through a coil of inductance L; the current swings back and forth, its energy moving between the two. Write the frequency f it rings at.
puzzle.name: Resonance of an LC circuit
puzzle.ask: Find f in kHz for a Tesla secondary of L = @{L} H and C = @{C} F.
puzzle.method: Charge obeys L d²q/dt² = −q/C: a harmonic oscillator of angular frequency 1/√(LC).
